name: AI Receptionist Script Generator
tagline: Free AI phone receptionist scripts for small businesses
description: Enter your business name, type, hours, services and common caller questions, and an LLM (Llama 4 Scout on Cloudflare Workers AI) writes four things: a call greeting, a numbered call-flow script (bookings, quotes, urgent jobs, after-hours), receptionist-style FAQ answers, and a system prompt to paste into voice agent tools like Vapi, Retell or Synthflow. Free, no sign-up, inputs not stored. For tradies, salons and clinics. Built by Luke Main with AI assistance.
